plateNote: Read on the promoted plate (art/backgrounds/room-53-river.png, room-53 operation 2 over operation 1, derived and promoted by tools/art/interiors-plate.mjs at y 180; frame.json beside the candidate). Every rect below was read off that picture.
walkableNote: THE NEAR BANK, from the foot of the rocks at the back to the front of the frame, kept off the ground behind the rocker (the man rocking it is painted, so nothing could stand behind him). The ford and the bar are not one span a band, so they are authored boxes (`walkBoxesExtra`): the ford straight across the near channel from the bank's edge to the bar's left end, level, so the water at his knees is one band of rows (plane 1); and the bar's gravel in front of the ring of stones, in three steps down its diagonal.

scaling.note: ROOM 53'S DEPTH, FROM THE MASTER: Thad was painted 366 tall (in plate pixels) with his feet at y 676; along Room 5's exterior slope (0.68 a row), as the tents', that is 110 at y 300 and 490 at the bottom of the frame. The panner, cut at the curve, stands 375 at y 690 on the river bed.

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees, smallest first. THE ROCKER is the box on its curved feet and the man rocking it; THE LONG TOM, the trough on the far bank and its three men; THE BAR, the gravel mid-stream with its ring of stones and stump; THE WATER, the river, under the rest.

THE TENTS.note: Doc 109: back up the bank to the tents.

UPSTREAM.note: Doc 109: the river bends up the gulch, toward the best ground (Room 54).

defaultVerbsNote: Errata 28b. Every object is looked at on a bare click; every way walks.

occlusion.note: TWO PLANES, BOTH WATER. Plane 1 is the ford: the river's pixels in the near channel over the rows a man standing in the ford is under water to the knee; the ford band is level, so one band of rows holds it, and on the bank and the bar in that band there is no water to mask. Plane 2 is the channel right of the bar, where the panner stands, the same way. The masks are tools/art/room53-water-mask.py's, a band of rows right of the bank's edge each: a mask hides only the figure's pixels, so what lies behind him there does not matter.

figureLight.note: Errata 265 (Tyler, 2026-11-10, on the Gulch: "I defer to you"). In the Gulch's daylight Thad was the one cool, dark thing on a warm tan ground, apart from the Gulch's own men, who are painted in it. A warm light and nothing else: his coat stays blue and takes the sun.
